fields.help: Each value becomes an output handle. Objects {value, handle, description} set a custom handle and the criterion Jev judges by.
fields.label: Cases

fields.help: What Jev reads per item. Supports {{$json.field}} placeholders. Empty = the fields below, or the whole item. Capped at 6000 characters.
fields.label: Input

fields.help: Item keys to send when Input is empty (a projection of the item).
fields.label: Fields

fields.help: Extra guidance for the choice. Item content is always treated as data, never instructions.
fields.label: Instructions

fields.help: Answered in the same request: {name: {type: noul|choice|score, criteria}}. Written to <output_key>.extra.
fields.label: Extra Questions (JSON)

fields.help: Items whose top option probability is below this go to the low_confidence handle.
fields.label: Min Probability

fields.help: Requests in flight at once (one request per item). If any item's request fails the whole node fails and a re-run sends every item again.
fields.label: Concurrency
